why: Deckhand detects the harness (environment variables) and `dh next` returns these few lines: the right syntax, not a generic one. Details: references/harness.md.

hermes.background: terminal(command=…, background=true, notify=["Ready in"]) → session_id; process_manage(action="wait", session_id=…, timeout ≤ 180). Never `nohup … &`. `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
hermes.limits: terminal: 180 s default, 600 s foreground max (longer is auto-promoted to background — do not re-run it). execute_code: state is lost on timeout/interrupt/30 min idle; inside it `from hermes_tools import terminal`.
hermes.delegate: delegate_task(tasks=[{goal, context, output_schema}], ≤ 10) — one task per .deckhand/work/AGENT-n.md, all in ONE call; no {x} or <x> in any task text (the whole batch is refused); steer early with action="steer".
hermes.todo: todo_list(todos=[one item per step: id, content, status], merge=true) from `dh workflow todo` (each item already carries id, content, status); tick with `dh workflow step ID done`. One item in_progress at a time.
hermes.browser: browser_navigate refuses localhost: check pages with curl; visual QA = a screenshot file + vision_analyze(image_url=path, question=…).
hermes.transcript: dh autopsy --latest reads this session from state.db (read-only).
hermes.cron: `dh ops add [bot] --runner hermes` writes the bot into $HERMES_HOME/scripts and returns the exact cronjob(action="create", no_agent=true, script=...) call to show the owner, then make: zero model tokens per tick, the script's stdout is the alert. Verify with cronjob(action="run", job_id=...).
hermes.context: Hermes loads ONE project file, first match wins: .hermes.md → AGENTS.md → CLAUDE.md. `dh init` writes its resume block into AGENTS.md, and into .hermes.md when the owner has one.
hermes.install: the skill lives in $HERMES_HOME/skills/[category]/deckhand (each profile has its own; install.ps1 / install.sh update every one); the session store is $HERMES_HOME/state.db.
hermes.cron_verify: cronjob(action="run", job_id=[the id create returns])   # fires once now; its stdout is the alert
hermes.cron_note: show the owner this cronjob call, then make it: a no-agent job costs no model tokens per tick, and the bot's secrets are read from the Deckhand vault by name (dh vault set NAME)

config.note: Hermes asks consent once per hook command on first use; check with `hermes hooks doctor`

hermes.skill_load: skill_view(name="[name]") loads it (its references: skill_view(name="[name]", file_path="references/…"))

claude-code.background: Bash with run_in_background; wait with Monitor (never sleep loops). `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
claude-code.delegate: Agent tool, one agent per .deckhand/work/AGENT-n.md, launched in one message.
claude-code.transcript: dh autopsy --latest reads ~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl; `dh resume --install-hook claude` starts every session from RESUME.
claude-code.context: CLAUDE.md (a new one imports AGENTS.md); `dh resume --install-hook claude` starts every session from RESUME.
claude-code.cron: `dh ops add <bot> --runner github` (GitHub Actions) or `--runner cron` (the VPS crontab); both need the owner's push or ssh.
claude-code.install: `install.sh` / `install.ps1` copy the skill into every agent folder found.
claude-code.skill_load: the Skill tool loads it by name (or read the SKILL.md at its path)

codex.background: a background terminal; `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
codex.delegate: no sub-agents: build the AGENT-n.md packages one after the other, or one Codex session per package.
codex.todo: `dh workflow todo --format md` as the plan.
codex.transcript: export the chat as JSONL (role, content) → dh autopsy --workflow chat.jsonl; the run log .deckhand/runs.jsonl is always read.
codex.cron: `dh ops add <bot> --runner github` (GitHub Actions) or `--runner cron` (the VPS crontab); both need the owner's push or ssh.
codex.install: `install.sh` / `install.ps1` copy the skill into every agent folder found.
codex.context: AGENTS.md (read by most agents; CLAUDE.md can import it): `dh init` writes the resume block there.

config.note: Codex asks you to review and trust a new hook once before it runs

codex.skill_load: read the SKILL.md at its path (Codex loads skills from ~/.codex/skills and ~/.agents/skills)
